critical_interpretation.nominal_vs_realized_beam: The requested scalar Gaussian waist is 2 um, but the fitted field-plane effective waists are about 6.37-6.44 um. This is therefore a nominal-w0=2 um source diagnostic, not a realized 2 um beam certificate.
critical_interpretation.raw_vs_equal_power: Raw Q retains physical absorbed-power differences. Equal-power normalization is used only to compare spatial shape; no saved Q artifact was rescaled.
